name: extension
description: Schemo Bridge — browser extension that hands the requests of chosen tabs to the desktop app.

scripts.build: pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:firefox && pnpm build:edge
scripts.build:chrome: rimraf dist/chrome && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=chrome parcel build --dist-dir dist/chrome --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/chrome
scripts.build:firefox: rimraf dist/firefox && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=firefox parcel build --dist-dir dist/firefox --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/firefox
scripts.build:edge: rimraf dist/edge && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=edge parcel build --dist-dir dist/edge --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/edge
scripts.dev:chrome: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/chrome && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=chrome parcel watch --dist-dir dist/chrome --no-hmr
scripts.dev:firefox: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/firefox && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=firefox parcel watch --dist-dir dist/firefox --no-hmr
scripts.dev:edge: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/edge && cross-env SCHEMO_TARGET=edge parcel watch --dist-dir dist/edge --no-hmr
scripts.zip: pnpm build && pnpm zip:chrome && pnpm zip:firefox && pnpm zip:edge && pnpm zip:source
scripts.zip:source: rm -f artifacts/schemo-bridge-source-$npm_package_version.zip && mkdir -p artifacts && git ls-files | zip -q -@ artifacts/schemo-bridge-source-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm lint:firefox
